description: This file defines the PathAlias entity class for Drupal, including its properties, methods, and behaviors related to URL alias management.

classes.name: PathAlias
classes.description: Represents a URL alias entity in Drupal, managing path and alias properties, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the PathAlias entity, including path, alias, and language code.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Pre-save hook to trim whitespace and slashes from the alias value.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Post-save hook to clear cache for the path alias.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Post-delete hook to clear cache for deleted entities.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label for the entity, which is the alias.

methods.name: getCacheTagsToInvalidate
methods.description: Returns cache tags to invalidate, specifically 'route_match'.
